name: Mid
note: INDEX BASE CHANGED. Mid counts the first character as 1; String.Middle counts it as 0. Subtract 1 from the start argument.

name: InStr
note: INDEX BASE AND SENTINEL CHANGED. InStr returns a one-based position and 0 when not found; IndexOf returns a zero-based position and -1 when not found. Rewrite the comparison, do not just rename.

name: InStrB
note: INDEX BASE AND SENTINEL CHANGED, as for InStr.

name: MidB
note: INDEX BASE CHANGED, as for Mid.

name: Redim
note: Keyword rather than a documented member, so it does not appear in the generated index.

name: Val
note: Global function. Str, Format, Hex and CStr changed alongside it; check each separately.

name: Screen
note: Global function returning a screen by index; replaced by the Displays array on Application.

name: ListBox.Headings
